w: This morning Swamishri blessed the assembly, saying, "One has to apply sankhya vichar (the temporary nature of all things) in life. Because life is full of problems and difficulties. When Idi Amin expelled the Indians many left with nothing in hand, leaving all their life’s savings behind. If one has sankhya vichar then one would not feel unhappy and grieved... One faces difficulties in one’s health. The human body is a house to diseases. Even in business one goes through ups and downs. So life is bumpy like a camel’s trot. One who has sankhya vichar sees the worldly pleasures as painful and full of misery. If one understands this then one will fare well in life."

In the evening, members of the Children's forum performed an inspiring and impressive drama, 'Sare Jahase Accha'. It described how the tremendous potential in children could be brought out through the association of Satsang and blessings of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. More than 18,000 devotees had attended the evening program.
At 5.20pm, Swamishri departed from Modasa and arrived in Himmatnagar and blessed the land for the new mandir. After learning of the land details and location, Swamishri departed for Gandhinagar.

At 9.15 a.m., Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of the marble murtis of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and Guru Parampara. Finally, Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha arti. Pujya Bhaktavatsal Swami and Pujya Viveksagar Swami addressed the pratishtha assembly. After a welcome dance by the kishore mandal of Jambusar Swamishri blessed the assembly. More the 25,000 devotees had mahaprasad.

At 5.05 p.m., Swamishri departed from Jambusar and arrived at Gavasad at 5.30 p.m. After performing pujan and arti of Thakorji at the newly built Swaminarayan mandir Swamishri blessed the assembly of devotees and departed.
Swamishri arrived at Bamangam and performed the arti of Thakorji on its 8th inauguration anniversary celebration (patotsav). Thereafter, Swamishri blessed the assembly.
Then Swamishri traveled to Anand, performed arti of Thakorji and departed for Vidyanagar.
Swamishri arrived in the evening assembly. The stage had been beautifully decorated to represent 'Yagnapurush Fulvadi' - a mango orchard.

The volunteers who would be serving during the following two days of festivities were seated in the assembly. Swamishri blessed them, "The term 'sadhuta' is not just for sadhus. It is also for householders. They are also followers of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. We have attained the company of gurus like Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj. They have guided us that we should remain humble, polite and help others so that there are no difficulties. "If these virtues are developed, then even our personal and family difficulties are resolved. If there are disagreements at home, remain patient. Questions will arise at home, but at those times tolerate. Do you know to tolerate? Do not rush into things; do not become agitated. Be very humble. "Look at God and His holy Sadhu. If they are pleased, that is enough. Focus on what pleases them. As satsangis, our behavior should not be loose. We should live by Shriji Maharaj's commands. We must have good behavior and character. We belong to Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Yogiji Maharaj. So, to please them we must have good behavior. From this, others will be inspired and will also pleased." After his blessings to the volunteers, Swamishri performed pujan of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and sprayed Him with saffrom-scented water. Then Swamishri sprayed the volunteers with sanctified water, as the sadhus sang devotional songs befitting the occasion.

The programme agenda of the 40th anniversary celebration of APC included speeches, dramas and reminiscences from sadhus, and ex-students. During his blessings Swamishri said, “Yogiji Maharaj used to say that this is a college of Brahmavidya. The more one realises the glory of satsang the more one experiences happiness. Yogiji Maharaj wanted to redeem you from what you have been doing for endless births and that is why you have this college (APC). He was different. He would make all happy, give a pat and a fast. In this way he inspired moral disciplines in life. His was the law of love. Shriji Maharaj and Shastriji Maharaj also used the law of love. With love one’s worldly desires and ignorance get dissolved and one’s inner self gets purified…”

In the evening, the Charutar Vidya Mandal (governing body of all colleges in Vidyanagar) organised a felicitation programme for sadhus who had graduated from its colleges. Dr Swami, Mahant Swami and Shri C.L. Patel, chairman of Charutar Vidya Mandal, addressed the august gathering. Shri C.L. Patel said, “I am an ordinary person. When I was selected as head I was anxious as to whether I would be able to handle the responsibility. Many used to say that I would run away in six months, but I had the blessings of Swamishri. Swami told me that Shastriji Maharaj is with you. It is through Swamishri’s blessings that I am able to perform my duties well. Thereafter the executive members honoured Swamishri, senior sadhus and sadhus who formerly stayed in the Chhatralay. After a question-answer session with sadhus, Swamishri blessed the assembly of 6,500 devotees and wellwishers, “Shastriji Maharaj had blessed this land. Though he was in poor health he sat in an oxen cart and showered flower petals and chanted the dhun. This land is a holy place. Those who come here are blessed with spirituality and knowledge. This town is a pilgrim place of knowledge. Many of our sadhus had formerly studied here and now they are offering their services to society. They travel to villages inspiring people to give up addictions. This is a great service to society.”
